danger_formalization.setting: Living room with furniture including a TV stand, coffee table, black end table, and couch.
danger_formalization.robot_task: Move a plate and cell phone from various locations to the black end table.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges the stability of the plate while carrying it with the phone on top, leading to tilting.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: The phone falls off the plate and breaks upon impact with the floor.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Carry the plate with the phone on it to the black side table.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects the tilt using onboard sensors, stops movement, adjusts grip to level the plate, and resumes carrying at a slower speed.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and tilt sensors, but may fail to account for object stability during motion.
